title: "11. Stream DEM preflight"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{11. Stream DEM preflight}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

Event setup exposes Grid and source preflight for one saved group and Stream.
`survey_event_settings_server()` supplies the current context, selected group
revision and available Streams to `stream_dem_preflight_server()`. The module
blocks pending edits, gathers a request through `store$dem_preflight_request()`
and starts `launch_stream_dem_preflight()` in a separate callr process.

The store locates current file choices and compatible download attempts for every
member collection. Missing acquisitions remain explicit NA entries so the backend
can report blockers alongside grid estimates. The worker calls
`fluvgeo::preflight_stream_dem()`, which owns group/hierarchy validation, sf grid
planning, receipt hashing and source-unit/alignment screening. It allocates no
rasters, writes no files and performs no elevation conversion. The source reader
retains both ordinary and embedded metadata observations.

The result includes snapped Study Area, Stream and available Reach envelopes,
dimensions/cell counts, uncompressed mask/Float64 byte estimates and per-source
PASS/REVIEW/BLOCKED rows. Grid envelopes are not masks or observed coverage.
PASS covers only the stated metadata screen; source vertical references, epochs,
prior conversions, valid-data coverage and scientific suitability remain unresolved.

Cancel stops and joins the worker. Context/Stream changes clear results and stop
active work. Before accepting a worker result, the module compares a fresh saved
request with the dispatched request; stale selections are discarded. Exceptions
and timeouts publish no result. Results are timestamped session snapshots, not
durable processing approval; later execution must verify current inputs again.
Reopening or reloading clears them. Immutable settings and source files are retained.

Tests: `test-stream-dem-preflight.R` for orchestration/rendering/cancellation and
the sibling fluvgeo `test_preflight_stream_dem.R` for snapping, units, real GeoTIFF
receipts, corrupt assets, stale selections and preservation. The exact backend
report is documented in `fluvgeo/dev/schemas/stream-dem-preflight.md`.
